name: LowBIt — benchmarking toolkit
description: An open-source suite of lightweight, deterministic microbenchmarks for computer architecture and ML performance evaluation. LB-ML-001 implements the transformer scaled dot-product attention kernel with reproducible workloads and reference validation.

name: net-ingress
description: A network ingress subsystem written in C, built to understand what actually happens to raw bytes when they first enter an operating system, before a socket or application-level interface processes them.

name: os-symmetry-synchronization
description: Operating-system synchronization modelled using permutation groups, with scheduling in S_n, mutual exclusion as stabilizers, and round-robin fairness as cyclic actions, verified computationally in Python.
focus: Operating Systems / Abstract Algebra / Mathematical Modelling

name: network-queue-control
description: A variational approach to network queue control showing that constant-rate packet injection minimizes delay and queue growth under convex cost models, linking calculus of variations with OS networking.

name: energy-optimal-cpu-scheduler
description: An educational exploration of energy-aware CPU scheduling, studying how execution timing can minimise power for fixed workloads and illustrating DVFS and performance-power trade-offs in modern processors.
focus: Operating Systems / CPU Scheduling / Energy Efficiency
